body:
**Original comment by agriggio (Bitbucket: [agriggio](https://bitbucket.org/agriggio), GitHub: [agriggio](https://github.com/agriggio)).**

----------------------------------------

Hi @Hombre, I took a \(quick\) look at the code, and I have started playing with it. It’s already quite good! A couple of comments:

1. I agree with most of your choices, but I’d like to use lists of numbers in the `arp` files rather than individual entries for all the fields in each knot. So I’ll change that
2. I think having a default rectangle in the area mask is just confusing now, so I’ll start empty there
3. for controlling the roundness factor, I think using the mouse scroll wheel \(possibly while holding `shift`\) would be quite nice. You can already change the brush size in the brush mask in this way, so the support is already there – shouldn’t be hard to add
4. finally, I saw you took the `polyFill` algorithm from a webpage. Would it be possible to include also the copyright/license of the code in the comment right above it?

I guess that’s it for now. I will keep playing with this for a while, but I expect to merge quickly! :thumbsup: 

‌
